```{r}
work_dir = "results_5_dim8"

setwd(work_dir)
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(labelled)
library(ggplot2)
files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
for (file in files) {
  cat("Loaded:", file, "\n")
}

prepare_data <- function(result, file_name) {
  # Define methods to analyze
  methods <- c("NonPara_Transfer_Tuned")

  # Generate quantile data for each method
  quantiles_list <- lapply(methods, function(m) {
    # 1 meas max and 2 means mean
    quantile_df <- apply(result[result$method == m, "mean_value", drop = FALSE], 2, function(col) {
      quantile(col, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
    })
    colnames(quantile_df) <- m
    quantile_df
  })

  # Combine quantile data and reshape it to long format
  quantiles <- do.call(cbind, quantiles_list)
  quantiles_long <- reshape2::melt(quantiles, variable.name = "Method", value.name = "Value")
  
  # Add a column with the file name for faceting
  quantiles_long$Dataset <- basename(file_name)
  
  return(quantiles_long)
}





all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(file) {
  result <- load(file)
  result <- get(result)
  prepare_data(result, file)
}))
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract 'n' (e.g., 200 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    n = as.numeric(gsub(".*_n_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", Dataset)),
    
    # Extract 'similarity' (e.g., 0.4 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    similarity = as.numeric(gsub(".*_simi_(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?).*", "\\1", Dataset))
  )
all_data <- all_data %>%
  rename(Method = Var2) |> filter(n!=500)


custom_labeller <- labeller(
  n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),  # Format 'n' as "n = ..."
  similarity = function(value) paste0("" ,value)  # Format 'similarity' as "similarity = ..."
)

# Plot with customized facet labels
plot <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2 ) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +  # Apply custom labeller
  labs(
    x = "Method", y = "Mean MSE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),  # Center the title
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6, angle = 20)
  ) #+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange", "darkgreen"))
library(stringr)

all_data_1 = all_data
all_data <- all_data_1 %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",

    TRUE ~ Method
    

  ))
all_data$Method <- factor(all_data$Method,
                          levels = c(
                                     "Late Fusion with Nuisance"
                                     ))
plot1 <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2 ) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +  # Apply custom labeller
  labs(
    x = "Method", y = "Mean MSE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),  # Center the title
    #axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
    #strip.text = element_text(size = 6, angle = 20)
  ) + scale_y_log10()
ggsave(
  filename = "mean_mse_plot.pdf",  # Specify the filename
  plot = plot1,                        # Specify the plot object
  width = 10, height = 12,             # Adjust dimensions as needed
  dpi = 300                           # Set the resolution
)
original = all_data
rm(all_data)
```

```{r}
work_dir = "/semi-transfer-learning/results_finetune_new8"
setwd(work_dir)
n = 500
similarity = 1
all_combined <- NULL
for (n in c(100, 200)) {
  for (similarity in c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)){
    similarity= (similarity)
    folder_path <- paste0(work_dir, "/mse_n_", 
                        n, "_simi_", similarity)
    output_file <- sprintf("%s/mse_n_%d_simi_%.2f.RData", work_dir, n, similarity)

    rds_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
    rds_data <- lapply(rds_files, readRDS)
    read_and_add_metadata <- function(file) {
      data <- tryCatch({
        readRDS(file)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("Error reading %s: %s", file, e))
        return(NULL)
      })
      if (!is.null(data)) {
        data$method <- rownames(data)
        data$dataset <- sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(file))
        seed_number <- as.numeric(sub(".*_(\\d+)$", "\\1", data$dataset))
        data$seed <- seed_number
      }
      return(data)
    }
    
    # Load all RDS files and add metadata
    rds_data <- lapply(rds_files, read_and_add_metadata)
    all_data <- do.call(rbind, rds_data)
    # Combine all dataframes into one
    all_data <- all_data[order(all_data$seed), ]
    
    max_per_row <- apply(all_data[,1:5], 1, max)
    mean_per_row <- apply(all_data[,1:5], 1, mean)
    median_per_row <- apply(all_data[,1:5],1, median)
    task1 <- all_data[,1]
    task2 <- all_data[,2]
    task3 <- all_data[,3]
    task4 <- all_data[,4]
    task5 <- all_data[,5]
    output <- data.frame(
      max_value = max_per_row,
      mean_value = mean_per_row,
      median_value = median_per_row,
      task1 = task1,
      task2 = task2,
      task3 = task3,
      task4 = task4,
      task5 = task5,
      seed = all_data$seed,
      method = all_data$method,
      n = rep(n, length(max_per_row)),
      similarity = rep(similarity, length(max_per_row))
    )
    save(output, file = output_file)
    all_combined <- rbind(all_combined, output)
  }
  
}
files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)

all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(file) {
  result <- load(file)
  result <- get(result)
  prepare_data(result, file)
}))
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract 'n' (e.g., 200 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    n = as.numeric(gsub(".*_n_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", Dataset)),
    
    # Extract 'similarity' (e.g., 0.4 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    similarity = as.numeric(gsub(".*_simi_(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?).*", "\\1", Dataset))
  )
all_data <- all_data %>%
  rename(Method = Var2) |> filter(n!=500)
all_data

custom_labeller <- labeller(
  n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),  # Format 'n' as "n = ..."
  similarity = function(value) paste0("" ,value)  # Format 'similarity' as "similarity = ..."
)
all_data$Method = "Global Fine-tuned Late Fusion with Nuisance"
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

BASE <- "/semi-transfer-learning"

dims  <- c(8)
ns    <- c(100, 200)
simis <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)

fmt_simi <- function(x) {
  s <- sprintf("%.1f", x)            # "1.0", "0.4"
  sub("\\.0$", "", s)                # -> "1", "0.4"
}

all_rows <- list()

for (dim in dims) {
  root <- file.path(BASE, sprintf("results_finetune_new_time%d", dim))

  for (n in ns) {
    for (simi in simis) {

      folder <- file.path(root, sprintf("mse_n_%d_simi_%s", n, fmt_simi(simi)))
      if (!dir.exists(folder)) next

      files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "^time_seed_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
      if (length(files) == 0) next

      for (f in files) {
        dt <- fread(f)

        all_rows[[length(all_rows)+1]] <- data.table(
          dim = dim, n = n, similarity = simi,
          Method = "Global Fine-tuned",
          Value = as.numeric(dt$runtime_sec)
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

all_data <- rbindlist(all_rows, fill = TRUE)

```

```{r}
library(data.table)

BASE <- "/semi-transfer-learning"

dims  <- c(8)
ns    <- c(100, 200)
simis <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
lambda_lens <- c(100, 200)
fmt_simi <- function(x) {
  s <- sprintf("%.1f", x)            # "1.0", "0.4"
  sub("\\.0$", "", s)                # -> "1", "0.4"
}

all_rows <- list()

for (lambda_len in lambda_lens) {
  root <- file.path(BASE, sprintf("time_6_dim_8_w_lambda_len"))

  for (n in ns) {
    for (simi in simis) {

      folder <- file.path(root, sprintf("_n_%d_simi_%slambda_len%d", n, fmt_simi(simi), lambda_len))
      if (!dir.exists(folder)) next

      files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "^time_data_seed_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
      if (length(files) == 0) next

      for (f in files) {
        dt <- fread(f)

        all_rows[[length(all_rows)+1]] <- data.table(
          dim = dim, n = n, similarity = simi,
          Method = paste0("implemented_", lambda_len),
          Value = as.numeric(dt$time_nonpar_transfer)
        )
      }
    }
  }
}
all_data_implemented <- rbindlist(all_rows, fill = TRUE)
keep_simi <- c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)

all_data_implemented <- all_data_implemented[
  round(similarity, 1) %in% keep_simi
]
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

keep_simi <- c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)

# Combine + convert to minutes
rt <- rbindlist(list(all_data, all_data_implemented), fill = TRUE)

rt[, similarity := round(as.numeric(similarity), 1)]
rt <- rt[similarity %in% keep_simi]

# Value is currently seconds → minutes
rt[, Value := as.numeric(Value) / 60]

# Make sure facet vars exist
# If dim missing in some table, set it:
if (!"dim" %in% names(rt)) rt[, dim := 8]
rt[, dim := as.factor(dim)]
rt[, n := as.factor(n)]

rt[, Method := factor(Method)]

rt[, Method := as.character(Method)]

rt[, Method := fifelse(
  Method == "implemented_100",
  "Implemented",
  fifelse(
    Method == "implemented_200",
    "Implemented with More Parameters",
    Method
  )
)]


# Control legend order
rt[, Method := factor(Method,
                      levels = c("Global Fine-tuned",
                                 "Implemented",
                                 "Implemented with More Parameters"))]

p_runtime_box <- ggplot(rt, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    coef = 2,
    width = 0.65
  ) +
   facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y")  +
  #facet_grid( ~ n, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Time (minutes)") +
  scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02)))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    # remove x text completely
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

    # enlarge everything
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),

    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_runtime_box

ggsave(
  filename = "runtime_boxplot.pdf",
  plot = p_runtime_box,
  width = 14,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
rt_summary <- rt[, {
  q1  <- quantile(Value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3  <- quantile(Value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  med <- median(Value, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  
  lower <- max(min(Value, na.rm = TRUE), q1 - 1.5 * iqr)
  upper <- min(max(Value, na.rm = TRUE), q3 + 1.5 * iqr)
  
  list(
    median = med,
    lower = lower,
    upper = upper
  )
}, by = .(Method, n, similarity)]
p_runtime_bar <- ggplot(rt_summary, aes(x = Method, y = median, fill = Method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Time (minutes)") +
  scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
p_runtime_bar
```
